_comment: UserPromptSubmit is DELIBERATELY UNWIRED. The upstream omo hook fires on any prompt matching /(?:ultrawork|ulw(?!-(?:plan|research)))/i, which also fires on incidental mentions — including a conversation *about* ulw. This plugin is explicit-invocation-only: run the skill with /ulw:ulw. The handler and its 57 tests are kept intact; to restore auto-trigger, move the block below from _disabled into hooks.
